Synthetic Sonarpad test archives generated with WinRAR (no user data).
rar4.rar: RAR4; rar5.rar: RAR5; solid.rar: solid RAR5.
password.rar: encrypted headers and contents, password test-password.
Contents: Books/notes.txt, Books/Sub/notes.txt, Books/Sub/Città.mp3
(four arbitrary bytes, not playable audio), and Books/Empty.
unsafe.rar: RAR4 with one entry renamed to a ../ path and header CRC updated,
used to verify rejection before any extraction.
